title: Spanish Fort, Bucktown and West End
summary: Howard says the places he played at Spanish Fort, Bucktown and West End were white clubs.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: Uh huh. What about the Spanish Fort? Did you ever play there, go out there, any music out there?
Yeah, I have played out there, in different clubs, out in the Spanish Fort, in Bucktown.
Was the Spanish Fort mostly for whites, or was it colored art, or just all white?
What about West End? All white. It was all white in your days, because I understood one time it was colored. Well I don't know.
You don't remember when the color.

I don't remember when the color. I heard once back in 1898 or something like that, they changed it from white into colored. And I thought maybe it was colored ever since then or something. I don't know anything about that. When you were young then it was all white? No, I played on all in place, and I was just nothing like that.
Bucktown, that was all white clubs? White clubs.
Bucktown, maybe. That's what I wondered.
Doesn't make too much difference. West End? Yeah. Yeah.
